groups.name: core
groups.why: the SAM9 MPU (BGA-217) with its VDDCORE/VDDIOP/VDDIOM/+1V0 decaps (C100-C104, C15, C17-C23, C5-C7, mostly on B.Cu under the ball field), its two crystals and load caps, the VBG bias pair C16/R14 on U17, and the 39R USB series resistors at its HFSD pins (R2/R3 USB0, R4/R5 USB2, R15/R16 USB1: source termination at the MPU); C34/C36 (100nF/1uF VDD-IO, on the IO sheet) are held here as VDD-IO decaps: no IC of the sdcard group carries VDD-IO, so there they would sit outside the decap term while the grade still holds any VDD-IO cap within 5mm of an IC to the 4.24mm limit

groups.name: ddr
groups.why: the DDR2 x16 (BGA-84) with its 14 VDD_DDR decaps and the DDR_VREF divider R17/R18 with its caps C200/C217/C218 at the VREF ball J2; 44 bus nets go to U1

groups.name: power

templates.why: MCP16501A PMIC: three 2 MHz bucks (SW1-SW3 into L1-L3) plus a 300 mA LDO; datasheet DS20006388B has no layout figure, so a template from its Typical Application Circuit pin assignments (CIN per PVINx/PGNDx, L on SWx, COUT 22uF = 2x10uF per rail, LDO divider at LFB, 2.2uF at LOUT)

groups.why: the PMIC with its three buck stages (inductors L1-L3, 220nF input caps C24-C27 on PVIN1/2/3 and VIN, 2x10uF output caps per rail), the LDO's divider R9/R10 and output cap C11, its PWRHLD/nSTRTO pull-ups R7/R8, the power path into VIN (D2 from ACIN, P-FET Q1 from VBUS, AC_DET divider R1/R6), the rail test points TP4/TP6-TP9, and the power button SW1 on nSTRT (declared on the west edge, beside the USB-C entry)

groups.name: usb
groups.why: the USB-C receptacle (west edge, power entry VBUS and USB0 device data) with its ESD array U7, CC pull-downs R12/R13, VBUS cap C33, VBUS load R11 and the USB_DET divider R25/R26

groups.name: wifi
groups.why: the RTL8188CUS WiFi module on USB1 with its U.FL antenna connector AE1 on the module's ANT pad and its own VDD-IO caps C912/C914 (not on any schematic sheet of the MPU)

templates.why: RTL8188CUS is a WiFi MODULE that holds its own RF front end; its ANT pad goes straight to the U.FL AE1 with no parts between, so there is no matching network to template

groups.name: sdcard
groups.why: the microSD socket on MCI0 (its 7 MCI0 nets come from U1's south-west balls)

groups.name: flash
groups.why: the W25Q128 SPI NOR flash on SPI0 with its 100nF decap; its SPI nets also reach J3

groups.name: lcd
groups.why: the 2x22 1.27mm LCD header: 23 bus nets from U1's ball columns 1-3; declared on the east edge in intent_run.json edge_connectors (a through-hole wall goes on an edge, not through the routing field)

groups.name: expansion
groups.why: the 2x18 2.54mm expansion header on B.Cu (GPIO, UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, ACIN, VBAT); declared on the north edge in intent_run.json edge_connectors (45.7mm long, it can only lie along a 66mm edge)

groups.name: aux_headers
groups.why: the three 2x04 1.27mm headers: RMII RX (J4) and TX (J5) from U1's NW ball corner, and USB2 (J7) off R4/R5

groups.name: ui
groups.why: the user button SW2 (declared on the south edge) with its 1uF debounce cap C37, and the RGB status LED D4 with its three 180R resistors
